final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as row_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(row_count) as total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.weathprofile, step1.avg_bandwidth, step1.row_count, step2.total_count, CAST(step1.row_count AS REAL) / CAST(step2.total_count AS REAL) as ratio FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(avg_bandwidth) as avg_bw_share, AVG(row_count) as avg_count, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3 GROUP BY weathprofile) SELECT AVG(avg_bw_share) as final_avg_bw_share, AVG(avg_count) as final_avg_count, AVG(avg_ratio) as final_avg_ratio FROM step4
